title: iDRAC9 setup
content:
# iDRAC9 setup

Set the iDRAC address first, either in System Setup (press F2 at boot, then **iDRAC Settings → Network**) or with `racadm` from the host OS. Addresses come from [[Server inventory]].

## Network

```
racadm set iDRAC.IPv4.DHCPEnable 0
racadm set iDRAC.IPv4.Address 10.50.1.11
racadm set iDRAC.IPv4.Netmask 255.255.255.0
racadm set iDRAC.IPv4.Gateway 10.50.1.1
racadm set iDRAC.NIC.DNSRacName idrac-edge-hrb-01
```

## Accounts

Change the default password before the server leaves the staging bench:

```
racadm set iDRAC.Users.2.Password <NEW-PASSWORD>
```

## Time and logging

```
racadm set iDRAC.NTPConfigGroup.NTPEnable Enabled
racadm set iDRAC.NTPConfigGroup.NTP1 10.60.0.10
racadm set iDRAC.SysLog.SysLogEnable 1
racadm set iDRAC.SysLog.Server1 10.60.0.20
```

## Remote use

From the operations jump host:

```
racadm -r 10.50.1.11 -u <USER> -p <PASSWORD> getsysinfo
```

## Security checklist

- ☑ Default password changed
- ☑ iDRAC only reachable on the management network
- ☑ IPMI over LAN disabled unless a tool needs it (`racadm set iDRAC.IPMILan.Enable 0`)
- ☐ Replace the self-signed certificate with one from the internal CA
